Name: DE-Companies
Statement:
select  com.Name,
        com.Code,
        com.Oid as Oid,
        com.Name as Company,
        com.Oid as CompanyId,
        com.HasImage as CompanyHasImage,
        cur.Name as Currency,
        cur.Oid as CurrencyId,
        com.TimesheetStart,
        com.GanttChartResourceType as ResourceType,
        com.ProjectArticle,
        com.HoursType,
        com.RequiredHours,
        com.MarginType,
		art.Name as Article,
        art.Oid as ArticleId,
        com.CreatedOnUtc,
        cre.Id as CreatedById,
        cre.Name as CreatedBy,
        cre.HasImage as CreatedByHasImage,
        com.ModifiedOnUtc,
        com.ModifiedOnUtc as ModifiedOn,
        mod.Id as ModifiedById,
        mod.Name as ModifiedBy,
        mod.HasImage as ModifiedByHasImage
from    Company com 
            join UserLookup cre on cre.Id = com.CreatedBy
            left join UserLookup mod on mod.Id = com.ModifiedBy
            left join Article art on com.ProjectArticle = art.Oid
            left join Currency cur on cur.oid = com.currency
where	com.GCRecord is null
